test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The sales of an item of a company in 4-quarters are given below. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97df35cbd12826c53ff7a53c5c17b55286de1bd3a194e7fa71150c214e6485a5.png] 

If the difference in sales of item in 3rd quarter and 4th quarter is 36. then the total sale of the 1st quarter is _____.
solution:
**Calculation**

The difference in sales of items in 3rd quarter and 4th quarter = 17% - 11%

= 6%

6% → 36

44% → 6 × 44 = 264

**The total sale of the 1st quarter is 264.**
